title: 200章 木源城中无懦夫199章 我们已别无选择
lines: 就在徐林和闫佳伟还在为说服陈姝君而在努力的时候，突然听到周围不断响起阵阵的喧嚣之声，各种议论之声不绝于耳。
“快看，跃出城墙的两个人影是谁？”
“不知道，那个人不就是在酒楼敬酒的那个人么？他叫什么来着。”
“我记得他说他叫蔡愉。可是那个戴斗笠的怪异人物又是谁？感觉他手上氤氲的七彩雾气像是在哪里见过一般，对了你们有印象么？”
“这不是一直跟在张荼身旁的秦风招牌雾气么？一双手所笼罩的七彩雾气却是胜过了太多的神兵利器，他现在也已经是a级修士了。那张荼又该是何等修为呢？有没有突破a级啊。”
“如此说来，张荼是真的伤心了么？不愿再出手了。是了，这世间以他的修为，即便是妖祸降临，他亦是可以全身而退，又何苦为了背后捅刀子的人舍命搏杀呢？”
“背信弃义的是镇江城和建邺城，跟我们有什么关系？你没看到江城也是没有干出什么人神共愤的举动么？”
“没有么？你们是不是忘记了他与那名叫做子矜女子初见的样子了么？那誓言，不比伤害他本人的后果来得更恐怖么？”
蔡愉看着不远处的斗笠身影，嘴角露出一丝笑意，低声说道：“不愧是昔日王侯，如今竟是不打算自己上场么？仅凭借自己培养的新人，是不是太过于猖狂了些。”
秦风却是没有看向蔡愉，反而是一脸凝重地盯着光幕外的群妖，他们如今临近光幕，已经可以较为清晰地看清楚群妖的面庞，那似笑非笑的神情，以及眼中的讥诮，一切都是那么的清晰，一股死亡的阴影刹那间笼罩在心头。
第一次，尚未交战，秦风便是感受到了死亡的威胁，他知道，一旦他迈出光幕，势必会遭到所有妖物的联手打击，这种感觉，是那般的清晰，没有丝毫的怀疑。
秦风悬浮在光幕之前，与蔡愉对视一眼后，从彼此的眼中确定了自己的猜测，今日怕是群妖就是为了灭城而来，绝不容许丝毫的意外出现，在自己二人踏出光幕的第一时间，迎接自己的怕便是毁灭。
蔡愉打了一个眼色，示意自己也是无能为力。秦风点点头，随后便是扭头对着城头报以一个苦笑，双手一摊，表示自己也是无能为力。
“秦风感受到了危险，狗荼，你要去么？”子矜看着秦风的诡异举动，心中明白，在秦风表示想要出战之前，张荼曾经说过，在地脉守护的光幕前记得停留片刻，若是没有心血来潮的预警，才可离开光幕厮杀。
如今看来，一切都在张荼的预料之中。
摸了摸鼻子，张荼有些无语，按照他的想法，是想让秦风在高强度的战斗下进一步的开启自身的潜力。在经历轮回海之后，张荼觉得秦风的潜力远远超过了自己的预料，有着更多的进步空间。
所以才想着让秦风历练一下，享受一下被群殴的感觉，本来想着有着那个眼熟的男人蔡愉一起分担火力，危机应该不至于太大。但是万万没想到，自己谨慎的习惯，竟是直接救了秦风一次。
这一批围城的妖兽，明显认真了很多，或许在妖族的高层经历几次失败之后，开始正式将人族当作了一个颇具威胁的文明，开始渐渐直视人族的战力和潜力，因为今日的妖族，明显是想要速战速决，而且谨慎的很，不允许出现一丝丝的纰漏。
“没办法，如今老秦跟那个蔡榆只要敢出去，他们就敢杀。”张荼叹息一声，揉搓着子矜的脑袋瓜，不放心地叮嘱道：“你就在城头上看看就好，或者等到尾声之时再让你历练一下，决不可擅自出战。”
城头之上的议论声依旧没有休止，毕竟秦风和蔡榆的诡异行为，让他们心中百思不得其解，像是等待着什么一般，但是有一些机敏之人，已经猜到了等待的究竟是什么，原本死寂呆滞的眸子中又重新燃起了火焰。
生的希望，是这一刻，最强悍的兴奋剂。
果不其然，在秦风跃出的地方，又有一个头戴斗笠的人出现，看似缓步地迈步在空中，但是速度却是极快，转瞬间便是来到了秦风的身旁。
碧月光华闪动，一杆黝黑的长枪出现在众目睽睽之下。
“见过张大人，二十余载未见，大人风采依旧。”蔡榆凑了过来。
盯着这熟悉的脸庞，张荼的脑海中不断的浮现零星的碎片，半晌后幽幽地说道：“纯阳蔡榆，蔡兄弟，我们的确是好久不见。”
蔡榆的嘴角浮起一丝笑意，说道：“今日，仍需大人带头冲锋，说来惭愧，身为十阳之一的我，多少有些拖后腿了。”
无声地笑了笑，张荼说道：“天地桎梏而已，兄弟又何必介怀。再说了，你我兄弟，谁带头冲锋不一样？待到杀退妖孽，我们再把酒言欢，如何。”
就在这个时候，张荼一步迈出地脉守护的屏障，只见就在刹那间，铺天盖地各色妖力如同最绚烂的彩霞般横空而过，十数道神光照耀天地，直逼张荼而来。
即使已经进军s境界的张荼亦是感受到一股压力，身体的本能督促着迅速的闪避，但是身后的地脉守护却是不容许张荼在这个时候退避。
content_en:
While Xu Lin and Yan Jiawei were still trying to persuade Chen Shujun, they suddenly heard bursts of noise and various discussions.
"Look, who are the two figures jumping out of the city wall?"
"I don't know, isn't that man the one toasting in the restaurant? What's his name?"
"I remember he said his name was Cai Yu. But who is that weird figure wearing a bamboo hat? It feels like the colorful mist on his hand has been seen somewhere before. Do you remember it?"
"Isn't this Qin Feng's signature mist that has been following Zhang Tu? The colorful mist shrouded in his hands is better than too many magical weapons. He is now an A-level monk. So what kind of cultivation level should Zhang Tu have? Has he broken through to A-level?"
"So, is Zhang Tu really sad? He doesn't want to take action anymore. Yes, with his cultivation in this world, even if a monster disaster comes, he can escape unscathed, so why would he risk his life to fight for the person who stabbed him in the back?"
"It was Zhenjiang City and Jianye City that were treacherous. What does it have to do with us? Didn't you see that Jiang City didn't do anything that would make people and gods angry?"
"No? Have you forgotten the first time he met the woman named Zijin? Isn't that oath more terrifying than the consequences of hurting him?"
…
Cai Yu looked at the figure in a bamboo hat not far away, with a smile on his lips, and whispered: "As expected of the former prince, now he doesn't plan to play on his own? Isn't it too arrogant to just rely on the newcomers he has trained?"
Qin Feng did not look at Cai Yu. Instead, he stared solemnly at the demons outside the light curtain. Now that they were close to the light curtain, they could see the faces of the demons more clearly. The expressions that looked like a smile but not a smile, and the sarcasm in his eyes were all so clear. A shadow of death suddenly enveloped his heart.
For the first time, before the battle, Qin Feng felt the threat of death. He knew that once he stepped out of the light curtain, he would be attacked by all the monsters. This feeling was so clear that there was no doubt.
Qin Feng was suspended in front of the light screen, and after looking at each other with Cai Yu, he confirmed his guess from each other's eyes. He was afraid that the demons were coming to destroy the city today, and they would not allow any accidents. The moment they stepped out of the light screen, they were afraid of destruction.
Cai Yu winked, indicating that there was nothing he could do. Qin Feng nodded, then turned to face the city with a wry smile, spreading his hands to show that he was powerless.
"Qin Feng feels the danger, Gou Tu, are you going?" Zi Jin looked at Qin Feng's strange behavior and understood in his heart that before Qin Feng expressed his desire to fight, Zhang Tu once said that he should remember to stay for a while in front of the light curtain guarded by the earth line. If there is no sudden warning, he can leave the light curtain to fight.
Now it seems that everything is as expected by Zhang Tu.
Touching his nose, Zhang Tu was speechless. According to his idea, he wanted Qin Feng to further unlock his potential under high-intensity fighting. After experiencing the Sea of ​​Reincarnation, Zhang Tu felt that Qin Feng's potential far exceeded his expectations and there was more room for improvement.
That's why I thought of letting Qin Feng practice and enjoy the feeling of being beaten by a group. I originally thought that with the familiar man Cai Yu sharing the firepower, the crisis shouldn't be too big. But he never expected that his cautious habits would directly save Qin Feng once.
This group of monsters besieging the city are obviously much more serious. Perhaps after the top leaders of the monster clan experienced several failures, they began to officially regard the human race as a threatening civilization, and gradually began to look directly at the combat power and potential of the human race, because today's monster clan obviously wants to win a quick victory, and is very cautious, not allowing the slightest mistake.
"There is no way. Now if Lao Qin and that Cai Yu dare to go out, they dare to kill them." Zhang Tu sighed, rubbed Zi Jin's head, and warned him uneasily: "You can just watch from the top of the city, or wait until the end to let you practice. Never go into battle without permission."
There was still no end to the discussion on the top of the city. After all, the strange behavior of Qin Feng and Cai Yu made them puzzled, as if they were waiting for something. However, some astute people had already guessed what they were waiting for, and the flames were rekindled in their originally dead eyes.
The hope of life is the most powerful stimulant at this moment.
Sure enough, where Qin Feng jumped out, another man wearing a bamboo hat appeared. He seemed to be walking slowly in the air, but his speed was extremely fast, and he came to Qin Feng's side in an instant.
The green moon flashed, and a dark spear appeared in full view.
"I've met Mr. Zhang, but I haven't seen him in more than twenty years. His style is still the same." Cai Yu came over.
Staring at this familiar face, scattered fragments continued to appear in Zhang Tu's mind. After a while, he said quietly: "Chun Yang Cai Yu, Brother Cai, we have indeed not seen each other for a long time."
A smile appeared on the corner of Cai Yu's mouth and he said: "Today, you still need to take the lead in the charge. I am ashamed to say that as one of the Ten Suns, I am somewhat lagging behind."
Smiling silently, Zhang Tu said: "It's just a shackles between heaven and earth, brothers, why should we care about it. Besides, it's different between you and me, brother, who takes the lead in the charge? How about we drink and talk after we kill the monsters."
"Okay!"
At this time, Zhang Tu stepped out of the barrier guarded by the earth veins, and in an instant, overwhelming demonic powers of all colors passed through the sky like the most brilliant rosy clouds, and dozens of divine lights illuminated the heaven and earth, approaching Zhang Tu.
